i01.text: Once upon a time, last Tuesday or thereabouts, there was a kingdom called Krayzee.
i01.asr: Once upon a time, last Tuesday or thereabouts, there was a kingdom called Krazy.

i02.text: Its royal family did not hunt, or fish, or open hospitals. They flew.
i02.asr: Its royal family did not hunt, or fish, or open hospitals, they flew.

i03.text: In nineteen oh seven, the Royal Chemist, attempting a self-buttering crumpet, invented impossi-rubber instead.
i03.asr: In 1907, the royal chemist, attempting a self-buttering crumpet, invented impossi rubber instead.

i04.text: The King had a biplane made of it that afternoon, flew it into the cathedral, bounced off, and declared aviation perfectly safe.
i04.asr: The king had a biplane made of it that afternoon, flew it into the cathedral, bounced off and declared aviation perfectly safe.

i05.text: Every royal aircraft since has been made of the stuff. And every rule of the air was written for other people.
i05.asr: Every Royal aircraft since has been made of the stuff, and every rule of the air was written for other people.

i06.text: Somebody still has to read those rules out. That is the control tower.
i06.asr: Somebody still has to read those rules out. That is the control tower.

i07.text: The tower remains calm. Mostly. It has a therapist, and a great deal of tea.
i07.asr: The tower remains calm, mostly. It has a therapist and a great deal of tea.

i08.text: The House of Pomfrey Smythe has won the Royal Hangar for two hundred years. They fly in mauve. They are insufferable.
i08.asr: The House of Pomfrey Smythe has won the royal hangar for two hundred years. They fly in mauve. They are insufferable.

i09.text: Which brings us... to you. This morning, the Queen ennobled you, for reasons nobody can quite remember.
i09.asr: Which brings us... to you. This morning the Queen ennobled you for reasons nobody can quite remember.

i10.text: You have a title, an aeroplane, and absolutely no intention of waiting your turn.
i10.asr: You have a title, an aeroplane, and absolutely no intention of waiting your turn.

n21.text: Lord Rupert Pomfrey-Smythe cut in front of you on your first day. He has not apologised. He never will.
n21.asr: Lord Rupert Pomfrey Smythe cut in front of you on your first day. He has not apologized. He never will.

n22.text: He is on final approach now. Return the favour.
n22.asr: He is on final approach now. Return the favor.

n31.text: The Bishop is waiting for his blessing flypast. There is a queue for the runway, and nobody has filled up your tank.
n31.asr: The bishop is waiting for his blessing fly past. There is a queue for the runway and nobody has filled up your tank.

n32.text: Commoners queue. You have a button.
n32.asr: Commoner's Q, you have a button.

n41.text: Lord Rupert has bought a biplane. It is mauve. He has challenged you to a race: the church, the castle, and home.
n41.asr: Lord Rupert has bought a biplane. It is mauve. He has challenged you to a race. The church, the castle, and home.

g_cut.text: that was a cut-in. On my final. It has been noted. In ink.
g_cut.asr: That was a cut-in on my final. It has been noted in ink.

g_land.text: you are number one. Apparently. Cleared to land, I suppose.
g_land.asr: You are number one, apparently. Cleared to land, I suppose.

r_cut.text: I say! That was my approach, you jumped-up little baronet!
r_cut.asr: I say that was my approach. You jumped up little baronet.

i_jump.text: you were number five for departure. You are now, it seems, airborne.
i_jump.asr: You were number five for departure. You are now, it seems, airborne.

i_fuel.text: refuelled, on the Crown's account. The Crown has been informed.
i_fuel.asr: Refueled on the crown's account, the crown has been informed.

i_bowser.text: a fuel bowser is being driven up the runway after you. Please do not ask how.
i_bowser.asr: A fuel bowser is being driven up the runway after you. Please do not ask how.

t_race.text: um, there are two of you on the runway. Is this a race? Are we allowed races?
t_race.asr: Um, there are two of you on the runway. Is this a race? Are we allowed races?

t_win.text: And the winner is... sorry. Sorry! I'm not supposed to say that on frequency.
t_win.asr: And the winner is... sorry, sorry, I'm not supposed to say that on frequency.

r_race.text: Do keep up, new money. The church, the castle, and home!
r_race.asr: Do keep up, new money, the church, the castle and home.

r_lose.text: Mother will hear about this. Mother hears about everything.
r_lose.asr: Mother will hear about this. Mother hears about everything.

r_win.text: Ha! Two hundred years of breeding, darling. Better luck next season.
r_win.asr: Ha! Two hundred years of breeding, darling. Better luck next season.
